name: cfbd-data-extension
description: Claude Desktop extension: CollegeFootballData.com API access with the key kept in OS secure storage

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --minify --outfile=server/index.js --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.pack: npm run build && mcpb validate manifest.json && mcpb pack . ../dist/cfbd-data.mcpb
